name: DEXFORCE
summary:
DexForce develops embodied-intelligence technology combining robot hardware, simulation, vision and learned control. Founded in 2021, its portfolio includes the DexVerse simulation engine, DexWorldModel world models, DexSense vision sensors and the DexForce W1 Pro humanoid robot.

The company uses simulation and real-world experience to develop robots capable of manipulation in changing environments. Its products connect data generation, perception, model training and physical execution, with applications across intelligent manufacturing and commercial services. Alongside complete robots, DexForce supplies enabling software and sensing technology, allowing its embodied AI approach to be used in different robot configurations and operating scenarios.
